zh: 位置 i 必须正好被 target[i] 次操作覆盖。这些操作中，最多只有 target[i−1] 次能从左边相邻位置延续过来，其余都必须从 i 开始新开。
所以每当 target[i] 比前一项高，就必须新开 target[i]−target[i−1] 个区间，首项也必须新开 target[0] 个；反过来，按高度维护活跃区间，上升时开新区间、下降时结束多出来的区间，就恰好能达到这个下界。
答案初值为 target[0]；从第二项起，累加 max(0, target[i]−target[i−1])；输出总和。
en: Position i must be covered by exactly target[i] operations. Of those, at most target[i−1] can continue from the neighbor on the left, and the rest must start at i.

So whenever target[i] is higher than the previous item, target[i]−target[i−1] new ranges must start, and the first item needs target[0] new ranges; conversely, keeping active ranges by height, opening ranges on rises and closing the extra ones on drops, reaches this bound exactly.
Start the answer at target[0]; from the second item on, add max(0, target[i]−target[i−1]); print the total.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Going from left to right, the first element needs target[0] new operations; after that, add as many operations as the difference only when the current element is higher than the previous one. Sum the first element and all positive differences.

## Proof of correctness

At most target[i−1] of the operations covering position i can continue from its left neighbor, so every positive rise must open at least that many new ranges, and the first element must open target[0] ranges as well. Maintaining active ranges by height, opening ranges on a rise and ending the extra ranges on a drop, forms every target height exactly and reaches this lower bound.

## Complexity

Time O(n), auxiliary space O(1) excluding the input.
